senses.definition: a long-handled saw with a curved blade

quotations.old_english: Ðá ic, on morgne, gefrægn mǽg óðerne billes ecgum on bonan stælan
quotations.english: then on the morrow, I have heard of the other kinsman setting on the slayer with the edges of a bill

quotations.old_english: Geseah ðá sige-eádig bil, eald sweord eótenisc
quotations.english: then he saw a victorious bill, an old giant sword
